authorized_claims.claim: N0 and N1 are non-nested under the frozen upstream-DROP typing because they make contradictory exact predictions for Δg.
A single directly measured upstream DROP from q=g=1 is a minimal separating intervention basis.
Bevy realizes the N0 independent-layer kernel with DROP (-1,0,-1), RESTORE (+1,0,+1), and gate-DROP (0,-1,-1).
golang/net HTTP/2 push realizes the N1 cross-coupled kernel with DROP (-1,-1,-1) and RESTORE (+1,+1,+1).
Both kernels have rank 2, so rank alone does not identify the architecture class; kernel orientation relative to typed q/g coordinates does.
At least two non-nested architecture families are empirically required within the current q/g/action framework.
